description: The Italian Institute for Environmental Protection and Research (ISPRA) publishes national shoreline and coastal-defence mapping through its geospatial services. The existing seven dataset/service entries include shoreline editions, coastal-defence works and their download service. Five additional native views represent the backshore line in 2000, 2006 and 2020 and beach/coastal-strip geometry in 2000 and 2006. Their full metadata explicitly relates the service to shoreline change, defence works, bathymetry and seabed elevation. These complementary spatial layers can provide coastal-defence context for hazard exposure simulations; they do not supply flood probabilities or design loads. Coverage is the Italian coast, with edition years preserved in each member title. The new views declare public access under a CC BY 4.0 licence and expose map services; file availability and usage charges were not tested. Metadata dates are not treated as survey dates. No map, feature or data body was downloaded, so geometric accuracy, current completeness and the equivalence of individual editions remain unverified. Earlier source links and their seven components remain preserved. Related infrastructure inventories describe the assets whose exposure could be assessed.
